migrations.description: Sets "cache" on some executor-based target defaults whose caching was previously enabled by a target name default, maintaining compatibility with how cacheability resolved before Nx 23. Keys the migration cannot decide are left alone, and the targets resolving through them need "cache" set by hand.
migrations.name: 23-2-0-set-cache-on-executor-target-defaults

migrations.description: Finds local executors that declare a custom hasher, which is deprecated and will be removed in Nx 25. Rewriting a hasher as target inputs means reading what its code hashes, so the rewrite is driven by an AI prompt; the generator only reports each hasher.
migrations.name: 24-0-0-move-custom-hashers-to-inputs

migrations.description: Sets affected.legacy to true in nx.json so nx affected keeps selecting whole projects. Nx 24 selects individual affected tasks by default.
migrations.name: 24-0-0-enable-legacy-affected

migrations.description: Renames the ultracache target options "ignoredReads" and "ignoredWrites" to "ignoreReads" and "ignoreWrites", and renames .nx/workflows/sandboxing-config.yaml to ultracache-config.yaml with its "exclude-reads" and "exclude-writes" keys renamed to "ignore-reads" and "ignore-writes".
migrations.name: 24-0-0-rename-ultracache-ignore-options

migrations.description: Sets `readyWhen: { signal: true }` on `@nx/web:file-server` targets that get no `readyWhen` from their own configuration or `targetDefaults`, so tasks that depend on them with `waitFor: 'ready'` start once the server is listening. Those targets also get their build target as a dependency.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-add-ready-when-signal

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/rollup` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/playwright` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Replace `__dirname` with `import.meta.dirname` in `vite.config.mts`/`vitest.config.mts` files so they work with Vite's `configLoader: 'native'`.
migrations.name: update-23-2-0-use-import-meta-dirname

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/vitest` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/eslint` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Replaces the removed `setParserOptionsProject` generator option with `enableTypedLinting` in the generator defaults of `nx.json` and project configuration, so generators resolve typed linting as before.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-replace-set-parser-options-project

migrations.description: Update the Angular packages to 22.2 unless the workspace uses Cypress component testing or webpack Module Federation in an Angular project, which break with the webpack-dev-server and webpack versions Angular 22.2 installs.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-upgrade-to-angular-22-2

migrations.description: Sets `readyWhen: { signal: true }` on `@angular/build:dev-server`, `@angular-devkit/build-angular:dev-server`, `@angular-devkit/build-angular:ssr-dev-server` and `@nx/angular:dev-server` targets that get no `readyWhen` from their own configuration or `targetDefaults`, so tasks that depend on them with `waitFor: 'ready'` start once the server is listening.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-add-ready-when-signal

migrations.description: Removes generator defaults for the removed `@nx/angular:scam`, `@nx/angular:scam-directive`, `@nx/angular:scam-pipe`, and `@nx/angular:scam-to-standalone` generators from `nx.json` and project configurations.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-remove-scam-generator-defaults

migrations.description: Add the pnpm-workspace.yaml, patches, and local_path_modules paths to the outputs of @nx/js:prune-lockfile targets in pnpm workspaces, and the workspace root pnpm-workspace.yaml, package.json, and a pnpm-major runtime probe to their inputs, so a cache replay restores the pnpm install settings, patch files, and vendored local-path dependencies the executor now emits, and a change to the root pnpm install settings or a pnpm major switch does not replay a stale one.
migrations.name: update-23-2-0-add-pnpm-prune-lockfile-cache-config

migrations.description: Add the workspace root pnpm-workspace.yaml, the pnpm settings fields of the root package.json, and a pnpm-major runtime probe to the inputs of build targets that emit the pruned pnpm deploy output (webpack, rspack, vite, esbuild with generatePackageJson; next, remix, tsc, swc with generateLockfile), so revoking a build-script approval, changing another pnpm install setting, or crossing the pnpm 10/11 boundary does not replay a cached output that still carries the old one.
migrations.name: update-23-2-0-add-pnpm-deploy-output-cache-inputs

migrations.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/vite` executors, and `@nx/vitest:test` targets, to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.
migrations.name: remove-deprecated-executors

migrations.description: Replace `nxViteTsPaths` with Vite's native `resolve.tsconfigPaths`, then migrate the remaining deprecated vite configuration helpers while preserving custom behavior.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-migrate-config-helpers

migrations.description: Register @nx/js/typescript with its typecheck target in workspaces that use @nx/vite/plugin without it, since @nx/vite/plugin no longer infers typecheck targets except for Vue projects.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-register-typescript-plugin-for-typecheck

migrations.description: Add the `nxReadySignal()` plugin to the Vite configs of application projects, so that `@nx/vite/plugin` infers `readyWhen: { signal: true }` for their dev and preview targets; an AI prompt finishes the configs the codemod cannot edit safely.
migrations.name: update-24-0-0-add-ready-signal-plugin
